But the reality is, that Lord of Destruction really brought life into the game and Reaper of Souls did for Diablo 3 was Lord of Destruction did for Diablo 2, it really fixed a lot and fine tuned the game, making it much more fun.

Diablo 1 & 2 weren't the perfect unicorns we make them out to be - I had my quips with Diablo 3 as well, and I no longer play. But I often compared it to Diablo 2, normally to state how lackluster Diablo 3 was. But then, I took off my rose tinted goggles and went back and played Diablo 2, both vanilla and Lord of Destruction. Honestly, there's a lot about the game that Diablo 3 improved upon. Some features in Diablo 2 are absolutely painful. It's a great game, and it was especially great for its time - I put hundreds, if not thousands of hours into it. But let's be very clear, a lot of the things people say they 'dislike' about Diablo 3 made it a lot more accessible and just fucking fun to play compared to Diablo 2, and for a lot of people, that's what they want - a fun game.

The main limitation on phones is battery life, but it is very hard to make much further progress there. Do you think smartphone sales are likely to stall?
